Subject: Onsite pilot at Redwood HQ — availability and requirements

Hi Stephanie,

Wed like to run a one-day pilot at Redwood HQ to run two short demos and a hands-on session with our engineers. Target dates: Dec 20 or Dec 22, 9:00–15:00. Attendees: ~8 (mix of engineers and procurement).

Requirements:
- Two adjacent spaces (one for slide/demo, one for hands-on laptops)
- Small lunch room for boxed lunch + 30 minutes
- AV support (projector + lav + HDMI adapters)
- Escort from lobby to rooms, visitor badges for all attendees
- NDA in advance (legal prefers DocuSign)

Could you confirm availability and any day-rate pricing for space/AV/escort? Also let me know where to upload the signed NDA.
